environment.description: Same container deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string parameters using pattern `(?i)(?:'|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|alter\s|exec\s|0x[0-9a-f])` with action BLOCK and priority 0, and (2) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT (not block). The custom regex rule inspects SingleQueryArgument for each of: 'warehouse', 'name', 'sort'. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule has blocked 2,847 requests in the past 30 days matching SQL injection patterns in query parameters. WAF logging to S3 shows matched payloads containing quote characters and SQL keywords in the warehouse parameter specifically.
